title: A Real-Life Dragon Was Found in Thailand
mediaSource: mountain horned dragon Thailand lizard close up, Acanthosaura syrax, spiny lizard rainforest

scenes.title: A real-life dragon was found in Thailand
scenes.narration: A new lizard species with horn-like spines along its neck and back has been discovered in the mountains of Thailand. Its appearance has already earned it comparisons to a real-life dragon.
keywords: mountain horned dragon Thailand close up real photo

scenes.title: Its name is Acanthosaura syrax
scenes.narration: The new species is called Acanthosaura syrax. Researchers identified it in high-elevation forests inside Mae Wong National Park in western Thailand.

scenes.title: It lives above 1,300 meters
scenes.narration: The lizard was found in evergreen forest more than about thirteen hundred meters above sea level. So far, it appears to live within a very narrow range in Thailand's mountain forests.

scenes.title: The spines are its standout feature
scenes.narration: Mountain horned dragons are known for sharp crests that run along the neck and back. This species also has a yellowish body and distinctive spines that help separate it from its close relatives.
keywords: mountain horned dragon spines close up

scenes.title: Even its name comes from a dragon
scenes.narration: Researchers named the species syrax after Syrax, the dragon from House of the Dragon. The name fits an animal that already looks like something from fantasy.
keywords: yellow mountain horned dragon close up

scenes.title: This tiny dragon may help protect its forest
scenes.narration: Because the species seems limited to a small area of high mountain forest, habitat changes could threaten it. Researchers hope this tiny dragon can become a symbol for protecting its rare ecosystem.
keywords: Thailand forest reptile cinematic close up
